typography: enrichment-hall headings on ink-violet rail tabs, brass return chips and rose wax verdicts
composition: an enrichment hall with a positive-negative gate, a new-thing lane splitting good and bad faith, a return-target fork with a gratuitous lane and a two-way ledger closing on an offset strip
